steps.text: At first, I treated it as no more than an ordinary job.
A small, unremarkable famiglia needed my strength to find their footing in turbulent Siracusa.
But with every day that passed, they came to trust me more, even letting me in on important family meetings.
I knew it was never part of the contract, but I very much enjoyed the feeling of belonging with these people.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Yo, Umiri, my girl! Been a few days since I saw you. How you doing?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Here, some tangerine cream pudding. If I remember right, that's your flavor of choice, yeah?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: No need, I have my own.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Hey, screw you, be a little grateful!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: I heard you chased off those goons harassing us, all by yourself! Just wanted to show my appreciation!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Keep your distance from me. I'm just a hired thug doing what I'm paid to. I'll be leaving once I'm done.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: If your boss sees the two of us getting friendly, it won't end well for you.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: It'll be fine. He was telling me earlier, for a while now he's been thinking of inviting you in with us...

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...I recommend you ask around Siracusa about my reputation.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Who needs to ask? You're the strongest person we've ever met!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: If you ask me, better say yes right now. We'll get together for tonight's family dinner—

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: You say it's a family dinner, but it's usually more of a band concert...

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Hey, we might not be the strongest famiglia, but you can't beat our sense of camaraderie!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Besides, you joined in the jam session plenty of times. Everyone really gets along with you, y'know.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...We can talk about this when I'm free.

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: That's what you said last time—

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I'm going now.
I turned down his kind invitation.
But as I walked home, my heart was filled with some nameless emotion.
One I have never felt before.
That night, I lay on my bed, tossing and turning. I got no sleep at all.
Before the sun rose, I had packed all my things—

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...Who would come looking here?

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: Umiri. There's been a situation with the boss, and he wants you to take some of the heat.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: But I already decided to...

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: We've made arrangements with the prison. They're waiting for you downstairs.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: Here's your payment. If you don't think it's enough, we can always add more.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: Umiri, what's gotten into you today? I say something?

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: This is how it's always been, yeah? This is the deal—we pay up, you do the job.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: C'mon, get going. We'll find a way to get your sentence down to six months. That's no time at all. You'll be out before you know it.
As a hired hand, it's not uncommon at all to have to be the fall guy. I know my way around life in prison.
But just this one time, this one single time, I suffered like nothing else.
For six months, there wasn't a single moment that I wasn't thinking of getting out, of returning to the famiglia, to their band's parties.
I'd found for myself where I belonged.
But I never thought it would end like this—

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: The don's dead, everyone's dead! We had hundreds of people, and now it's just our dozen left!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: We busted our asses moving from Columbia to this stupid place, but you had to go and get everyone killed!
What happened in these six months?
I don't know. The only thing I do know is that—
Once again, I've lost my 'home'.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Umiri. You've done a lot for me, at great personal risk to yourself. You've earned a position from me.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: I permit you to join my famiglia.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...You know I've always been a lone agent. I won't be joining any famiglie.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Because you don't want to, or because you can't?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: I'm not like those ruffians who go about calling themselves 'Don', Umiri.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Over half my life I've been here, wrangling with the big famiglie. They're tricky, they're sly. Never once left this poker table.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: You want me to get you to a table with bigger stakes?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Clever girl.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: This is separate from making a deal. I need to do a lot more thinking when it comes to joining a famiglia.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: The only thing I need to consider in a deal is the money on offer. If I'm going to be part of a famiglia, I need to consider the character of its leader.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Kheheh, I know I don't have the best reputation. But that's precisely what we have in common, isn't it?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Umiri. Is anyone willing to take you in, aside from me?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Siracusa's a dangerous place. All you'll find under the banner of Famiglia e Ordine are conspiracies and schemes.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: How long since you had a peaceful night's sleep?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Lying on your cardboard boxes, dagger in hand in case anyone tries to sneak up on you...

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: 'The lone wolf finally finds a home'.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: A return to the pack, a restoration of rank and reputation... or a mutt's death in the wilds, your corpse quartered by hungry beasts.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: It's your choice.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: Boss, she's led some suspect folks here.
Sakiko's hands are shackled behind her. She cannot move them an inch.

steps.name: Serious Mobster
steps.text: There was another. He managed to run. We're sending boys after him.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Do you know this signorina, Umiri?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Don't you recall that we have old debts to settle?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Seems she holds something against you.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: I'll give you time, I'll give you space, Umiri. You handle this yourself.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I already said I don't know her...

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: This is your final test before you join my famiglia.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: This time... better not try to fake the scene with blood bags.
Sakiko and Umiri are left alone in the alleyway.
But both know there are people invested in how their duel ends.
Umiri knows the boss is watching.
Sakiko knows Morpheus is watching too.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I don't have anything against you. Why are you trying to get killed?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I am here to bring you back.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Bring me back?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Not back to the billiards room, but back to the place you're meant to be.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I don't understand what you're talking about.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Even so, I have to pull you out of this. I cannot allow you to throw your life away in this manner.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Your boss sent his underlings to stab Francis's people in the back.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I hardly believe that the man who stabbed you in the back would grant you the home you wish for.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: But... but...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Exploited like a piece, sacrificed like a pawn, again and again... Is this really the life you want? Is this the trust you so desire?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In all the time you've spent here, not once have you wanted to hurt a single soul.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Just a moment ago, I saw your case inside. Your bass is in there, isn't it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You never needed to suffer like this, Umiri.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Umiri... Let's get out of here. Together.
